name: Paper tear transition
summary: Full-frame torn-paper wipe that slides in to cover the frame or slides off to reveal the next scene.

params.name: mode
params.note: in covers the frame, out reveals it

params.name: at
params.note: start as a fraction of the shot (0..1)

params.name: atFrame
params.note: start frame inside the shot; overrides at

params.name: len
params.note: frames the tear takes to cross

params.name: seed
params.note: change for a different torn edge

author: krakujs
